notes.s: Jimin's solo: being loved as something the universe arranged in advance.
notes.t: Jimin's solo and the comeback trailer for Love Yourself 承 Her, August 2017, later re-released in a longer version on 結 Answer. 承 is the continuation in the four-part 起承轉結 structure the series is built on, and this is the arc at its happiest, before Singularity cracks the same imagery open. Its two central images, a mould and a cat, are probably the most-quoted lines in BTS's catalogue among Korean-speaking fans, and they are also the two that fan translations tend to render flatly.
k: 푸른곰팡이 is penicillium, the blue mould Fleming found by accident on a neglected dish. Korean science classes use it as the standard example of a lucky accident, so the word is doing the title's work in one image. Calling someone your mould is not flattering on its face; it means you are the accident that saved my life, and 날 구원해 준 in the next line confirms the medical reading.

Calico cats are almost always female and have long been treated as lucky, and the Japanese beckoning cat is a calico. Set against the mould, the pair becomes lucky accident and lucky charm, each claiming the other. 고양이 is also Jimin's own long-standing fan nickname, which is why the line lands the way it does live.

시리다 is the specific ache cold puts in teeth, fingers and eyes, and -도록 turns it into a measure, to the point of. So the blooming is painful and the pain is winter's, placed inside the series' warmest song. Keeping the cold loses the ache and keeping the ache loses the cold.
설레는 만큼 많이 두려워, 너만큼 나도 많이 무서워

-만큼 sets two things at equal size rather than ranking them. The verses pair the flutter with the fear and insist they match, which is the song's actual claim and not decoration. Substituting -보다 would make one outweigh the other and break the argument.

vocab.note: 우연히 is the adverb, by chance; 우연이 아냐 denies it
From 기쁘다 with -ㅁ, the same build as 느낌 and 어긋남
Also means to sing a song and, separately, to be full after eating

vocab.en: to ache with cold, be numbingly cold
vocab.note: For teeth, hands and eyes, not for weather, which is 춥다
A theology term for how a god governs events; not everyday Korean
The pre-excitement of a crush or a trip; English has no single verb for it
Heavier and more literary than 무섭다, which the song uses two lines later

vocab.en: to go awry, be out of alignment
vocab.note: For plans, bones and relationships that fail to meet properly

vocab.en: to be scheduled, be set in advance
vocab.note: 예정 is diary vocabulary, as in 예정일 for a due date, so fate turns up sounding like an appointment
Religious salvation; 구하다 is physical rescue, which is what Save ME asks for
Takes 를 or 와, so 널 만나러 and 너와 만나러 are both fine
Passive of 정하다; 정해진 거 is a done deal
